name: misu
description: Browser extension that redirects www.xiaohongshu.com to www.rednote.com

scripts.pack:zip: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force ./release -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path ./release | Out-Null; Copy-Item ./manifest.json ./release/; Copy-Item ./dist ./release/dist -Recurse; Copy-Item ./ui ./release/ui -Recurse; Copy-Item ./assets ./release/assets -Recurse; Compress-Archive -Path ./release/* -DestinationPath ./misu-extension.zip -Force"
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run pack:zip
